summary: Join our GIS course focused on Data Standardization and Interoperability. Master techniques to ensure seamless data integration and enhance your projects.
lede: Data Standardization and Interoperability in GIS helps you move geospatial data efficiently between platforms, software environments, and organizational boundaries. Across this five-day intensive course, you will address incompatible schemas, missing metadata, and proprietary formats through practical schema mapping, metadata harvesting, and automated validation pipelines. You will work with OGC Web Feature Services, PostGIS, ISO 19115, and the SpatioTemporal Asset Catalog specification for cloud-native discovery. The course also explores standardizing AI-driven feature extraction and provides templates, validation checklists, and architectural roadmaps to support interoperability initiatives.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for experienced geospatial professionals who are responsible for the architecture, management, and integration of spatial data systems across complex organizational environments.
audience: Interoperability Specialists focused on OGC® and ISO®
modules: Geospatial Standards and the Interoperability Framework
Web Services and OGC® API Implementation
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3 years of experience working with GIS software (ArcGIS Pro, QGIS, or similar) and a foundational understanding of spatial data formats. Familiarity with SQL and basic web service concepts is recommended. No advanced programming knowledge is required, though exposure to Python or ETL tools like FME is beneficial.
